agent.problem: The correct answer drops an important part of Paul's stated purpose. In 7:12, the Corinthians' earnestness was to be made clear "to you" in the sight of God. Saying only that it "would be clear before God" loses the recipient and can sound as though the purpose was for God to see their earnestness.

rule.text: When the baker leaves Prep, they understand the whole passage without missing an important detail.
